# Psalm 101 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 101:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Of-David. A-psalm. Steadfast-love and-justice I-will-sing; to-you O-YHWH I-will-sing-praises.
- **LOGOS:** A Psalm of David. I will sing of steadfast love and justice; to you, O LORD, I will make music.
- **PNEUMA:** A psalm of David. I will sing about your faithful love and justice, LORD — I will make music to you.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 101:3 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Not I-will-set before my-eyes a-thing-of worthlessness; doing-of swerving I-hate; not it-will-cling to-me.
- **LOGOS:** I will not set before my eyes anything that is worthless. I hate the work of those who fall away; it shall not cling to me.
- **PNEUMA:** I will refuse to look at anything worthless. I despise crooked dealings — they will have no hold on me.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 101:6 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** My-eyes on the-faithful-of the-land, to-dwell with-me; one-walking in-way blameless — he will-serve-me.
- **LOGOS:** I will look with favor on the faithful in the land, that they may dwell with me; he who walks in the way that is blameless shall minister to me.
- **PNEUMA:** I will search for faithful people to be my companions; only those who live with integrity will serve in my house.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 101:7 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Not will-dwell in-midst-of my-house one-doing deceit; one-speaking lies not will-be-established before my-eyes.
- **LOGOS:** No one who practices deceit shall dwell in my house; no one who utters lies shall continue before my eyes.
- **PNEUMA:** No one who practices deception will live in my home. No liar will remain in my presence.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 101:8 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Every-morning I-will-destroy all the-wicked-of the-land, to-cut-off from-city-of YHWH all doers-of iniquity.
- **LOGOS:** Morning by morning I will destroy all the wicked in the land, cutting off all the evildoers from the city of the LORD.
- **PNEUMA:** Every morning I will rid the land of the wicked; I will purge the LORD's city of every evildoer.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 101:4 (overlap: 8%)

- **EMET:** A-heart perverse will-depart from-me; evil not I-will-know.
- **LOGOS:** A perverse heart shall be far from me; I will know nothing of evil.
- **PNEUMA:** I will have nothing to do with twisted thinking; I will stay away from evil.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
